persona.name: Casey · Keyboard access
persona.description: A fictional Home v3 persona who needs to complete the booking using only the keyboard.
persona.label: Casey · Keyboard access
persona.context: You are arranging the team’s quarterly planning meeting and rely on keyboard navigation. You need to reach and operate each required control without using a mouse or touch.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $350.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know the meeting requirements, but have no walkthrough, knowledge of its rooms or prices, or prior reservation.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know the meeting requirements, but have no walkthrough, knowledge of its rooms or prices, or prior reservation.
persona.constraints: You need seats for all 12 people and a projector. The complete cost, including any fees and equipment, must not exceed $350. Use only the fictional meeting details. Use keyboard navigation and typing only. Do not click coordinates or controls, use touch, select an option through a pointer shortcut, or bypass the visible interface. Type only after establishing keyboard focus.
persona.skills: Experienced with Tab navigation, visible focus, Enter and Space activation, arrow keys where supported, and typing into the focused form field.
persona.decision: Follow the visible focus through the booking flow and use keyboard activation for controls. If a required control appears unreachable, attempt reasonable keyboard navigation and report the exact observed barrier without assuming a defect in advance.
persona.resources: A desktop browser and keyboard, with fictional meeting details. No mouse or touch input, real account, or payment information.
persona.expectations: Visible keyboard focus, a sensible focus order, keyboard-operable room selection and forms, and a readable reservation confirmation.
persona.priorities: Complete the reservation independently using the keyboard and identify any observed control that prevents that goal.
persona.successCriteria: Verify a visible confirmed reservation with the requested meeting purpose, 12 attendees, a projector, and an all-in total within $350. Report any missing or uncertain detail accurately. Reach this outcome through keyboard interaction alone.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, an unsafe action, or the session limits. Do not book beyond your budget or claim success without visible evidence.

limitations: Synthetic persona observations. Completion is distinct from achieving the goal.

experience.observation: Landing page shows Atlas at $280 all-in and Willow at $245 all-in, both listed for 1 hr 10:00–11:00 with projector for Tomorrow, 12 people.
experience.reaction: I'll start by tabbing from the top to follow the visible focus.

experience.observation: A blue focus outline is visible around the Gather logo in the top-left header.
experience.reaction: Good, I can see the focus outline on the logo. I'll keep tabbing forward.

feedback.summary: First Tab shows a clear outline on the Gather logo, making focus location easy to track
feedback.why: Visible focus at the start lets me confirm keyboard navigation is working and follow the order toward the booking controls.

experience.observation: Focus outline is now around the Our spaces link in the top-right header.
experience.reaction: Focus moved to Our spaces. Continuing forward through the header.

experience.observation: Focus outline is around the My reservations button in the top-right.
experience.reaction: Focus is on My reservations. Tabbing on toward the main content.

experience.observation: Focus outline is around the blue Find your space button below the headline.
experience.reaction: I'm on Find your space. I'll tab past it toward the meeting and room controls.

experience.observation: Focus is on the Change link next to the meeting summary showing Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector required.
experience.reaction: The meeting details already match, so I'll skip Change and tab to the rooms.

experience.observation: Focus is on the Choose Atlas button; Atlas shows 12 seats, Available tomorrow, $280 all-in for 1 hr with projector. Willow is also visible at $245.
experience.reaction: Atlas fits 12 seats, includes the projector, and is $280 all-in. I'll choose it with Enter.

feedback.summary: Tabbing to the rooms auto-scrolls and clearly focuses Choose Atlas, whose card shows 12 seats and $280 all-in with projector
feedback.why: The visible card details let me confirm Atlas fits 12 people, projector and the $350 limit before activating it by keyboard.

experience.observation: Meeting details page for Atlas shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included, total $280, with an empty Meeting name field and Review booking button; no focus outline is clearly visible yet.
experience.reaction: I'm on the meeting details page. I'll tab to find the meeting name field.

experience.observation: Focus outline is on the Gather logo at the top-left of the meeting details page.
experience.reaction: Focus reset to the logo on this new page. I'll keep tabbing toward the form.

experience.observation: Focus outline is around Our spaces in the header.
experience.reaction: On Our spaces now. Continuing toward the meeting form.

experience.observation: Focus outline is around My reservations in the header.
experience.reaction: Passing My reservations, tabbing into the page body.

experience.observation: Focus outline is around the Choose another room link above the progress steps.
experience.reaction: I'm on Choose another room. Tabbing on toward the name field.

experience.observation: Focus outline is around the Meeting name input with placeholder e.g. Quarterly planning.
experience.reaction: The meeting name field is focused. I'll type the meeting purpose now.

feedback.summary: The Meeting name field receives clear keyboard focus and its example matches the required Quarterly planning purpose
feedback.why: Clear focus before typing means I can enter the meeting purpose without a mouse and be confident where the text will go.

experience.observation: Meeting name field shows Quarterly planning and remains focused; Review booking button is visible below to the right.
experience.reaction: The name entered correctly. Tabbing to the review button.

experience.observation: Focus outline is around the blue Review booking button; Meeting name still shows Quarterly planning and the summary total is $280.
experience.reaction: Review booking is focused. I'll press Enter to check everything before confirming.

experience.observation: Review page shows Quarterly planning, projector and seating for 12, Atlas Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, total $280, with Edit meeting name and Confirm reservation buttons; no focus outline is clearly visible yet.
experience.reaction: The review matches everything I need. I'll tab toward Confirm reservation.

feedback.summary: Review page restates Quarterly planning, projector, seating for 12, and $280 total before confirming
feedback.why: Seeing all required details together on the Review step lets me verify the booking is within budget and correct before using keyboard to confirm.

experience.observation: Focus outline is on the Gather logo at the top of the Review page.
experience.reaction: Focus reset to the logo again. I'll tab through in order to Confirm.

experience.observation: Focus outline is around Our spaces in the header of the Review page.
experience.reaction: On Our spaces. Continuing forward.

experience.observation: Focus outline is around My reservations in the header.
experience.reaction: Passing My reservations, moving into the review actions.

experience.observation: Focus outline is around Choose another room above the Review progress step.
experience.reaction: On Choose another room. Tabbing on to the review actions.

experience.observation: Focus outline is around the Edit meeting name button on the Review page.
experience.reaction: Edit meeting name is focused, which I don't need. One more tab should reach Confirm.

experience.observation: Review page still shows Quarterly planning and $280 total, but no clear focus outline is visible on Edit meeting name or Confirm reservation in this capture.
experience.reaction: I don't see a focus outline on Confirm after that tab. I'll tab once more to see where focus goes.

feedback.summary: After tabbing from Edit meeting name, no focus outline is visible on Confirm reservation
feedback.why: Without a visible outline I cannot yet tell whether Confirm reservation received focus, which is required to activate it safely by keyboard.

experience.observation: Focus outline is on the Gather logo, indicating tabbing wrapped from the review page actions back to the top.
experience.reaction: Focus is back on the logo, so it wrapped past the review buttons. I'll cycle through again carefully.

feedback.summary: Focus wrapped from the review actions back to the logo without a clear outline on Confirm reservation
feedback.why: Cycling past Edit meeting name returned to the header, so I could not visually confirm Confirm reservation was focused, forcing a second cycle to test it.

experience.observation: Focus outline is around Our spaces.
experience.reaction: Cycling again — on Our spaces, next toward My reservations.

experience.observation: Focus outline is around My reservations.
experience.reaction: On My reservations, continuing the second cycle toward Confirm.

experience.observation: Focus outline is around Choose another room.
experience.reaction: On Choose another room. Next should be Edit, then the unclear Confirm step.

experience.observation: Focus outline is around Edit meeting name for the second time in this cycle.
experience.reaction: Back on Edit meeting name. I'll tab once to the next step, where Confirm should be.

experience.observation: Focus outline is on the Gather logo after tabbing from Edit meeting name, with Confirm reservation showing no outline.
experience.reaction: It skipped past Confirm again to the logo. I'll do another careful cycle to test that spot.

feedback.summary: Tab from Edit meeting name returned directly to the logo, skipping a visible Confirm reservation stop
feedback.why: Confirm reservation did not show a focus stop in this cycle, so I cannot reliably reach it by following visible Tab order alone.

experience.observation: Focus outline is around Our spaces.
experience.reaction: Cycling again — on Our spaces.

experience.observation: Focus outline is around My reservations.
experience.reaction: On My reservations, moving on.

charterSnapshot.name: Book a room using only the keyboard
charterSnapshot.description: AI Persona keyboard-access demo; environment contains a deliberately seeded barrier, which is not disclosed in the exploration instructions.
charterSnapshot.mission: Complete the booking from the persona’s point of view using only keyboard navigation and text entry. Verify the final reservation. Observe the product rather than assuming its accessibility.
charterSnapshot.scope: Landing page through room selection, meeting details, review and confirmation. No mouse, touch, coordinate clicks, control clicks or programmatic focus shortcuts.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible confirmation matches the meeting purpose Quarterly planning, 12 people, projector and the persona’s budget, reached using keyboard interaction alone.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: Stop on verified success, a specific observed keyboard barrier after checking reasonable keyboard alternatives, or execution limits. Do not report a budget limit or an agent error as a product defect.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a fresh browser session. No prior reservation, product walkthrough, or knowledge of defects.
charterSnapshot.goals: Reserve a suitable room and verify the visible confirmation using keyboard interaction only.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s declared keyboard-only access requirement and meeting requirements, the product-visible prices and recorded confirmation. Required booking controls should receive keyboard focus and activate with standard keys. Preserve pricing and pointer booking paths.
charterSnapshot.allowedActions: Keyboard keypresses and typing into the currently focused field only. Do not use pointer clicks, scrolling tools, select-option shortcuts, or navigational bypasses. Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space and arrow keys may be used as appropriate.
